title: Stars777 Teen Patti Hand Rankings
author: niyon
content:
Here’s the clear, no-nonsense breakdown every player in India needs.

Teen Patti is pure Indian card culture. Whether you’re playing at home with friends or on Stars777, the hand rankings decide who walks away with the pot. Get these rankings wrong and you’ll keep losing money you didn’t have to. Here’s the exact order used on Stars777, written the way real players talk about it.

1. Trail (Three of a Kind) – The King of Hands

Three cards of the same rank.

Examples: A-A-A, K-K-K, 7-7-7.

This is the strongest hand in Stars777 Teen Patti. When someone shows a Trail, the table usually goes quiet. Ace Trail is the highest, then King, and so on down to 2.

2. Pure Sequence (Straight Flush)

Three consecutive cards of the same suit.

Examples: A-2-3 of hearts, 9-10-J of spades, Q-K-A of diamonds.

A-2-3 of the same suit is the highest Pure Sequence. After that it follows normal rank order. This hand is rare and powerful – many players treat it almost like a Trail.

3. Sequence (Straight)

Three consecutive cards of mixed suits.

Examples: 5-6-7 (different suits), 10-J-Q, A-2-3.

Same ranking logic as Pure Sequence, just without the matching suit. Still a very strong hand on Stars777.

4. Colour (Flush)

Three cards of the same suit that are not in sequence.

Example: 2-7-K of clubs.

When two players both have Colour, the one with the highest card wins. If the highest cards are equal, compare the second, then the third.

5. Pair

Two cards of the same rank + one side card.

Example: J-J-4, 9-9-A.

Higher pair beats lower pair. If both have the same pair, the kicker (the third card) decides. Ace pair is the strongest, 2 pair is the weakest.

6. High Card

Nothing matches – just the highest single card.

Example: A-9-4 of mixed suits.

When everything else fails, the highest card wins. Ace is top, then King, Queen, and so on.

Quick Ranking Order (Highest to Lowest)

  1. Trail
  2. Pure Sequence
  3. Sequence
  4. Colour
  5. Pair
  6. High Card

Small but Important Rules on Stars777

  • Ace can be high or low in sequences (A-2-3 is valid and is the highest sequence).
  • Suits have no ranking value except when you need them for Colour or Pure Sequence.
  • In case of exact same hand strength, the pot is usually split (check the specific table rules).

Why This Matters for Indian Players

Most casual players in India still mix up Sequence and Pure Sequence or forget that A-2-3 is the top sequence. On Stars777, where the games move fast and the pots can get big, knowing the exact Stars777 Teen Patti Hand Rankings gives you a real edge. You stop calling when you shouldn’t and start raising when the odds are actually in your favour.

Practice these rankings until you can see them in two seconds. That’s how regular winners play.
